children: may test a resistance at $100.91 per barrel, a break above could open the way towards $103.02.

The market stabilized around a support at $97.47 twice. The stabilization suggests the formation of a temporary bottom. The support is close to $96.91, the 100% projection level of a wave c from $104.91, which serves as one of the endpoints of this wave.
A break below $97.47 may open the way toward the $93.85-$95.74 range.
